thread:
Samira Khan: FYI I ran the int4 bring-up for q4x with the new suffix-trim augmentation. We got a noticeable uptick in punctuation reorder / truncated bullets in the augmented cohort.

Samira Khan: short stats: 
``run: q4x-int4-175100
examples: 1,024
mismatch: 0.052
main_signals: [punctuation_shift, bullet_reorder, early_stop]
```

Ethan Wu: is suffix-trim the same flow we used for synth-joins? or the newer conservative trim that drops trailing newline tokens?

Samira Khan: newer conservative trim (v1.0.3). It removes trailing "\n" tokens after stitching examples. I suspect tokenizer tail heuristics + int4 kernel padding differences.

Priya Nair: can you paste two sanitized failing samples and their host fp16 outputs vs int4 outputs? helps decide if this is de-dup/golden overlap or quant drift.

Samira Khan: pasted snippets (sanitized):
- "Compare A vs B:
- A: list
- B: list" -> int4 cuts last bullet and reorders bullets
- "Policy summary: clause X || example Y" -> punctuation moved to end of line under int4

Marco Li: runtime recently changed attention offset rules for trimmed prefixes (PR #964). That could nudge KV indexing. If trimming changes token counts per-batch, different kernel selected for int4 path.

qbench-bot: [qbench] run=q4x-int4-175100 baseline=q4x-fp16-174950 delta=+5.2% ci=[+3.0%,+7.5%] signals=[punctuation_shift,early_stop]. details: https://qbench.local/runs/q4x-int4-175100

Ethan Wu: suggested triage: (1) rerun canary with suffix-trim disabled to see dataset augmentation isolation, (2) rerun int4 with `--kernelset=legacy-2025-11`, (3) create a micro-golden of 250 edgecases mirroring suffix-trim behavior and run targeted eval.

Priya Nair: I'll own (3). I'll de-dup micro-golden against main golden (fast fingerprint check) and include regen ids + sample-stamps. ETA 3h.

Marco Li: I'll run (2) and enable `--kvcache-trace` for 6 failing seeds. I'll upload KV dumps to s3://ci/qbench/kvdumps/q4x-175100/ and include first-256 tokens.

Samira Khan: I'll do (1) now and post the updated qbench run when complete. Muting suffix-trim from the baseline set for that run.

Ethan Wu: small ask: add `sample-stamp` format `<run>-<seed>-<ts>` to failing ids and include them in the ticket. Opening INF-1742 to track.

qbench-bot: [task] created INF-1742: "q4x-int4: suffix-trim augmentation regression" assigned to runtime+curation.

Samira Khan: thanks — I'll attach initial diffs and the micro-golden link once Priya uploads. Marking this as P1 for the bring-up since it's affecting longtail display stability. :exclamation:
